body.heading: Ideas arrive at the wrong time
paragraphs: You are halfway through one project when a shinier idea appears. Chasing it feels exciting, but a trail of abandoned half-projects is usually the result.
The interruption is not the problem. The fear of losing the idea is. If the idea has a safe place to wait, the fear quiets down.

body.heading: One page, no judging
paragraphs: Keep a single page or note titled 'Idea parking lot'. When a new idea shows up mid-project, write it down in one or two lines and return to your work. No evaluating, no planning, just parking.

Visit the lot when you are genuinely between projects. Some ideas will look dull by then, which is useful information. Others will have kept their shine, and those are worth your next stretch of attention.

takeaway: Park new ideas in one trusted place, and finish what is in front of you.
